title: Inquest called into man's death
subtitle: John Roberts died in police custody in 2016
article: An inquest will be held into the death of a man in police custody on Dec. 15, 2016.
John Roberts, 49, was pulled over by the Ontario Provincial Police for impaired driving, and later taken to the North Bay Regional Health Centre.
The inquest will examine the circumstances surrounding Roberts' death. The jury may make recommendations aimed at preventing similar deaths.
An inquest is mandatory under the Coroners Act.
The inquest is expected to last two days and hear from three witnesses.
The inquest will begin at 9 a.m. Nov. 26 at the North Bay Courthouse. Dr. Steven Bodley will preside as inquest coroner and Russ Wood will be counsel to the coroner.
